services.name: Cessna
services.desc: Our Cessna is an awesome way for couples to enjoy the beauty of Kauai. About This small plane will comfortably carry only two of you, one in the front co-pilot seat, and the other behind. Our interactive communication system with noise canceling headsets gives you the opportunity to share your experience with each other and the pilot in a more private setting, and with only two on board you may have a personal experience of the incredible beauty of Kauai. The windows are smaller than the AirVan and some describe the viewing difference to be a Van vs. a compact car – you can still see everything, but in a different way. Tour Route Starting in Lihue, you will first see Kipu Kai, the beach

services.name: Air Van
services.desc: Window Seats Only! About We love this G8 AirVan, our new touring plane from Australia, it can comfortably seat 6 passengers plus the pilot. There are no middle seats, every seat has large bubble windows for unobstructed views of Kauai. In our AirVan we can give you the highest quality air tour of Kauai, bar none. This roomy plane has huge bubble windows which give you an unobstructed wrap around view as well as a downward view. Communication with your pilot, and each other, is easy using our noise canceling headsets. You can enjoy the pilot's expertly crafted narration and artfully selected music, ask questions, share stories and have an unparalleled emotionally charged and rewarding visual
